function.name: lookup_stock
function.description: Look up the stock count for an item in a fictional shop.

messages.content: You are an assistant answering questions about a fictional shop. Use the supplied tool for inventory facts. Be brief.
We have 7 pending orders for notebooks. Check stock, then tell me whether we can fill them and how many notebooks will remain.
